record.purpose: Find the relevant county office and verify incumbent and jurisdiction before any correspondence. This is not a confirmed separate recipient.

sources.source_title: Official county or state public contact publication
sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive administrative inquiries within documented county legal remit and jurisdiction.
sources.limitations: Official county contact page and department homepage publish the same departmental mailbox. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer legal filing, service-of-process or independent complaint intake authorization. Confirm current mailbox, role and remit before use. Deliverability not tested.
